events.text: The Harington family owned Gleaston Castle until William Harington, 5th Baron Harington died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Harington family owned Gleaston Castle until William Harington , 5th Baron Harington died in 1458 .

events.text: The castle and barony passed to William Bonville, 6th Baron Harington through marriage.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The castle and barony then passed to William Bonville , 6th Baron Harington through marriage .

events.text: William Bonville died and the castle passed to Thomas Grey, 1st Marquess of Dorset.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died in 1460 and the castle passed to Thomas Grey , 1st Marquess of Dorset , again through marriage .

events.text: Gleaston Castle was likely abandoned around this time.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It is likely that around this time Gleaston Castle was abandoned .

events.text: John Leland noted a ruine and waulles of a castell in Lancaster-shire cawlyd Gleston Castell.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1540 , the antiquarian John Leland noted there is a ruine and waulles of a castell in Lancaster-shire cawlyd Gleston Castell
